Begin your weekend in Madrid by arriving at Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport (MAD). From the airport, take the metro (Line 8) to the Nuevos Ministerios station. This will take approximately 20-30 minutes, and the ticket costs around €2.50.
